name: eo-vercount
description: Lightweight website PV/UV counter on Tencent Cloud EdgeOne Makers (KV), compatible with Vercount and Busuanzi

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('public/assets',{recursive:true});" && terser src/client.js -o public/assets/client.min.js --compress --mangle && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const code=fs.readFileSync('public/assets/client.min.js','utf8');fs.writeFileSync('edge-functions/_shared/client-code.js','export const CLIENT_JS = '+JSON.stringify(code)+';\n');"
